title.narrative: Addressing antisemitism through education: a partnership with Australia

description.narrative: This 2-year programme advances education to prevent and counter antisemitism through teacher training in Australia, in ways that are context-relevant and contribute to addressing intolerance and prejudice more broadly:  To build knowledge, skills and attitudes to address antisemitism, UNESCO will implement capacity building for teachers, school directors and religious intolerance hotline staff in cooperation with a State level Ministry of Education and the Sydney Jewish Museum.  UNESCO and the Sydney Jewish Museum will develop a training curriculum on countering antisemitism through education and set of lesson activities aimed at educating about antisemitism through Holocaust education.
